title: Isolated flyback SMPS
goal: A reader must be able to trace mains rectification, primary switching, isolated secondary rectification, and optocoupler feedback regulation.

rubric.must: Four diode symbols marked 1N4007 form a bridge from AC MAINS to a 47 µF, 400 V bulk capacitor.
The transformer primary connects from the high-voltage rail to the STP7NK80Z N-channel MOSFET and its 0.33 Ω current-sense return.
A transformer symbol separates the primary nets from VSEC/GNDSEC, followed by an SS34 Schottky rectifier and 470 µF output capacitor.
The output is visibly labelled by the 10 Ω, 5 W load and the secondary return is distinct from the grounded primary return.
The TL431A divider feeds an LTV-817 optocoupler symbol whose transistor side returns to the UC3843 feedback connection.
The PWM controller block is visibly labelled UC3843 with GATE, CS, and FB connections.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG is the closer target because it includes nearly all required components, values, and controller labels, although its wiring contains serious errors that must be corrected.
